verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.synctera.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing per-version LLM-oriented markdown bundles: v2 with 668 pages and v0 with 529. The `_llms/v1` and `_llms/v2` markdown endpoints and `.md` doc pages are directly fetchable, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation explaining or guiding agent use of these llms.txt resources (e.g., usage instructions or agent-specific guidance).
